entities.summary: Martti Johannes Häikiö was a Finnish historian and writer. In 1978, Häikiö became an associate professor in political history at Helsinki University. He was also editor in chief and columnist in many journals and newspapers.

entities.summary: Martti Johannes Häikiö was a Finnish historian and writer. In 1978, Häikiö became an associate professor in political history at Helsinki University. He was also editor in chief and columnist in many journals and newspapers.
